verdict.rationale: Migrating historical books is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. The pack documents no migration tool or importer from another accounting system that preserves transaction detail. The full-parity REST API is only a developer building block, and bank statement import and 'Copy settings to an organization' are adjacent features, so none of them earn credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
